name: 5F-EDMB-PINACA
summary: 5F-EDMB-PINACA is a designer drug and synthetic cannabinoid. In 2018, it was the fourth-most common synthetic cannabinoid identified in drugs seized by the Drug Enforcement Administration.

uses.text: 5F-EDMB-PINACA is a designer drug and synthetic cannabinoid.

pharmacology.en: Like other synthetic cannabinoids of its family, it switches on the CB1 receptor in the brain, the same receptor THC acts on.
pharmacology.zh: 它和同家族的其他合成大麻素一樣，會活化腦中的CB1受體，也就是THC作用的受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它和同家族的其他合成大麻素一样，会活化脑中的CB1受体，也就是THC作用的受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: In 2018 it was the fourth most common synthetic cannabinoid in drugs seized by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration, which shows how quickly these compounds come and go.
fact.zh: 2018年，它是美國緝毒署查緝藥物中第四常見的合成大麻素，可見這類化合物流行與消退的速度之快。
fact.zhHans: 2018年，它是美国缉毒署查缉药物中第四常见的合成大麻素，可见这类化合物流行与消退的速度之快。
